metadata.name: Filament Ledger — low stock v1
metadata.description: Run actions for a recorded low-stock crossing. Empty spool selection means all eligible spools. Startup, threshold edits and continuing shortage do not trigger it. Recorded quantities can be estimates; inspect confidence or weigh the spool.

spools.name: Physical filament spools
spools.description: Empty means all eligible spools. Missing selected entities never broaden the scope.

actions.name: Actions
actions.description: Native Home Assistant actions, run once for each published crossing.

data.message: {{ spool_name }}: {{ remaining_g }} g recorded remaining (threshold {{ threshold_g }} g). Confidence: {{ confidence }}. Weigh the spool if the recorded quantity is uncertain.
data.title: Filament stock

conditions.value_template:
{{ spool_id | length > 0 and occurrence_id | length > 0
   and remaining_g is number and threshold_g is number
   and threshold_g > 0 and remaining_g < threshold_g
   and (selected_spools | length == 0
        or trigger.event.data.get('low_stock_entity_id') in selected_spools) }}
